notes.model: Sonnet is the project default on purpose. This system is text-heavy teaching, not hard reasoning — Sonnet handles it and costs a fraction of Opus. Switch with /model only if a session genuinely needs it.
notes.deny_list: These four are the guardrail, enforced mechanically rather than by prompt alone. list_problem_solutions and get_problem_solution would hand over the answer. submit_solution and run_code would let Claude solve it for you — the whole point is that YOU submit on leetcode.com.
notes.setup: Run 'setup' as your first message in a fresh clone. It builds config/ and curriculum/ and verifies the MCP connection.
notes.auth: The LeetCode MCP runs public-only by default. See .env.example to turn on LEETCODE_SESSION for verified progress.
